pr_title: Loaders: Bubble parsing errors in remaining data texture loaders.
pr_body:
Fixed #26457.

**Description**

This PR updates the remaining data texture loaders so they properly throw parsing errors. 

`EXRLoader` already throws errors so there are just some formatting updates. `LogLuvLoader` and `RGBELoader` required some updates. 

`TIFFLoader` and `RGBMLoader` use external modules for parsing which I did not want to monkey patch.

issue_context.title: DataTextureLoader: Properly bubble parsing errors to onError
issue_context.body:
### Description

The core issue is laid out in #26412 - but DataTextureLoader subclasses are not properly propagating errors in a way that can be caught or handled by applications.

### Solution

Issue #26412 added a temporary fix for the issue but does not correctly address the issue. My recommendation is for the following loaders that extend `DataTextureLoader` should throw errors in the `parse` function rather than logging warnings (see [here](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/1775695d0d2a4fca1b3c3839272c561c6e7bc7e3/examples/jsm/loaders/RGBELoader.js#L408-L411), [here](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/1775695d0d2a4fca1b3c3839272c561c6e7bc7e3/examples/jsm/loaders/RGBELoader.js#L428)). It's possible other loaders have a similar issue.

- [x] EXRLoader (#26499)
- [x] LogLuvLoader (#26499)
- [x] RGBMLoader
- [x] TGALoader (#26497)
- [x] TIFFLoader
- [x] RGBELoader (#26499)

### Alternatives

none
